items.information: Competitions in highly populated areas - like this one - tend to fill quickly, and do have limited spots. Please [register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GetToWorkChicagoland2023/register) as soon as you are able, in order to secure a spot in this competition. If you are on the [competitor list](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GetToWorkChicagoland2023/registrations) and are no longer planning on competing in this competition, please cancel your registration. Please take note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GetToWorkChicagoland2023#competition-schedule) is subject to change depending on whether this competition is running ahead of time, or behind on time. We are not responsible for no-shows if we begin an event early, and you miss your opprotunity to compete. We need to keep the competition moving along, so we recommend arriving 20-30 minutes before you are scheduled to compete/judge. We may also change the original schedule after competitors register for the competition based on registration numbers for each event, but we will not add or remove full events or change the order of events. At the end of the competition, please pick up any garbage left over and dispose it. This will allow the opportunity that we can use this venue again for more competitions in the future. items.name: Loutraki Open 2023
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaVpJIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4b69d3e8ec74c2e903cc944222c628b961b4e6ae/357003767_748136693777038_1928584195019389868_n.jpg) To Loutraki Open 2023 είναι ο 4ος διαγωνισμός WCA στην Ελλάδα για το 2023. Ο διαγωνισμός γίνεται στις 16 και 17 Σεπτεμβρίου 2023 στην Κορινθία που είναι η γενέτειρα του Παναγιώτη Βερδέ, ιδρυτή και εφευρέτη των Ελληνικών κύβων [V-CUBE](https://www.v-cubes.com/) , που έχουν φτάσει σε 116 χώρες. Οι Ελληνικοί κύβοι [V-CUBE](https://www.v-cubes.com) ήταν αυτοί που από το 2008 επέκτειναν την σειρά των κύβων από το 5χ5. Το Loutraki Open 2023 τελεί υπό την αιγίδα του WCA και διοργανώνεται από το ηλεκτρονικό κατάστημα [GamesUniverse.gr](https://gamesuniverse.gr/el/) , την [V-CUBE](https://www.v-cubes.com/) και την [V-Games](https://v-games.eu/) , όπου ανήκουν στην εταιρεία [Καινοτομίες Βερδέ ΑΕΒΕ](https://gamesuniverse.gr/el/content/8-poioi-eimaste). Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε στο [Sport Camp](https://www.sportcamp.gr/el) στο Λουτράκι για μια μοναδική εμπειρία και γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τόσο την παρούσα σελίδα όσο και τις επόμενες σελίδες Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA KAI να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RS768gK0Vrg&feature=youtu.be) Σημείωση Αποδοχής κινηματογράφησης ή φωτογράφισης. Οι διαγωνιζόμενοι και οι συμμετέχοντες με την συμμετοχή τους στο Loutraki Open 2023 αυτόματα συμφωνούν με την πιθανή χρήση των εικόνων τους από τους διοργανωτές σε προωθητικές ενέργειες, κοινωνικά δίκτυα και άλλες ψηφιακές ενέργειες. Οι online εγγραφές ανοίγουν στις 31.07.2023 και κλείνουν στις 11.09.2023. Loutraki Open is the 4th WCA Competition in Greece during 2023. The competition is taking place on the 16th and 17th September 2023 at Korinthia prefecture which is the place of birth of Panagiotis Verdes, who is the founder and inventor of the Greek Cubes [V-CUBE](https://www.v-cubes.com/) that have reached 116 countries. The Greek Cubes [V-CUBE](https://www.v-cubes.com) were the ones that since 2008 they have extended the cube line with cubes of more than 5 layers. Loutraki Open 2023 is an official WCA competition and is co-organized from the e-shop [GamesUniverse.gr](https://gamesuniverse.gr/el/) , [V-CUBE](https://www.v-cubes.com/) and [V-Games](https://v-games.eu/) , that they all belong to [Verdes innovations S.A](https://gamesuniverse.gr/el/content/8-poioi-eimaste) . Grab your cubes, get ready, read the rules and come to [Sport Camp](https://www.sportcamp.gr/el) at Loutraki for an unforgettable experience and celebration of cubing! Please read the following and the rest of the tabs very carefully. Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site AND pay the registration fee as described in the next tabs. items.name: NCR Please Be Quiet 2023
items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ### (EN) ### Please be quiet Most of the events at this competition are ***blindfolded events***, which require a significant amount of learning, practice and concentration. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to please remain quiet at this competition to allow competitors to concentrate. ### Note for new competitors Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), or the Fewest Moves Challenge, this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you. ### Mailing List We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand for competitions in southern Ontario and are regularly planning and announcing more competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. ### (FR) ### Silence s'il vous plaît La plupart des épreuves de cette compétition sont des épreuves ***avec les yeux bandés***, qui nécessitent une quantité importante d'apprentissage, d'entraînement et de concentration. Toutes les personnes présentes, y compris les participants et les accompagnateurs, sont priées de ne pas faire de bruit afin de permettre aux participants de se concentrer. ### Note pour les nouveaux compétiteurs Bien que les novices soient les bienvenus s'ils savent résoudre des casse-tête les yeux bandés (voir le règlement [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)) ou le défi des moindres mouvements (3x3 Résolution optimisée), il se peut que cette compétition ne soit pas la meilleure expérience pour les nouveaux compétiteurs. Veuillez envisager de vous inscrire à [une autre compétition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) si celle-ci ne vous convient pas. ### Liste de diffusion Nous travaillons fort pour répondre à la demande de compétitions dans le sud de l'Ontario et nous planifions et annonçons régulièrement de nouvelles compétitions. Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou (https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.name: BMME 3x3 Day 2023
items.information: ##### *English version is below* #### **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr, euch BMME 3x3 Day 2023 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Florian Truckenthanner und Pranjal Khan und delegiert von Viktor Kalmar. Diesesmal findet das Turnier in den Räumlichkeiten des BMME statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier herzlich willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Da dies ein sehr kleines, ruhiges und auch kurzes Turnier wird sind generell keine Gäste erlaubt (da wir auch von der Räumlichkeit begrenzt sind) - falls jedoch ein Teilnehmer einen Gast dabei haben muss, zb. weil du Minderjährig bist und du deinen Erziehungsberechtigten dabei haben willst, dann schreibt uns bitte noch vor dem Turnier eine E-mail mit einer Begründung und mit dem Namen des Gastes. Generell herrscht absolute Ruhe während des Gesamten Turnieres (ausgenommen von den Pausen) da es sich hauptsächlich um Blind Events sowohl als auch um Fewest Moves handelt. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ----- #### **English:** We are happy to announce the BMME 3x3 Day 2023 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Florian Truckenthanner and Pranjal Khan and delegated by Viktor Kalmar. The results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. This competition is going to be quite small, short and especially quiet and because of this no guests will be allowed at this competition (also because it is a small room). If you have a good reason why a guest should accompany you (e.g.: you are a minor and you want to have your legal guardian with you), then please let us know before the competition via email (include the name of the guest and the reasoning). It has to be absolutely quiet during the whole competition (except during the breaks) because we mostly have Blind and Fewest Moves events only.

A inscrição terá custo de R$ 30 e o pagamento deverá ser feito via PIX para a chave planeta.rio.open@gmail.com. O comprovante de pagamento deverá ser enviado para o mesmo email; 2. Cada competidor terá direito a 1 (um) ingresso no valor de meia entrada (R$10) para um acompanhante. Os demais acompanhantes, se houver, deverão pagar o valor inteiro do ingresso (R$20). **Esta taxa é aplicada somente aos acompanhantes** e deverá ser paga apenas nos dias da competição, não devendo ser feita junto a transferência PIX para o pagamento da inscrição; 5. Para informações adicionais, verifique o site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do email planeta.rio.open@gmail.com, bem como o delegado por meio do email isoares@worldcubeassociation.org; 6. Favor ler o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição. **REGISTRATION** The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements: 1. Register through the WCA website. The registration costs R$30 and must be paid via PIX transfer to planeta.rio.open@gmail.com. Proof of payment must be sent to the same email address; 2. Carefully choosing the events. Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind; 3. Fill in the following [form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd7w5hqTt8BB-GbKildtIHah7ygjYonOWLStzRI10ndMDp8gA/viewform) to help keep track of competitor and guest names by the Planetarium team involved with the organization; 4. To gain entry and stay in the competition, **guests** must purchase tickets at the Planetarium ticket booth. Each competitor will be entitled to 1 (one) ticket worth half price (R$10) for a single guest. The other guests, if any, must pay the entire ticket price (R$20). **This fee is applied only to guests only** and must be paid only on the days of the competition, and must not be made via the PIX transfer for payment of registration; 5. For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (planeta.rio.open@gmail.com), or the delegate (isoares@worldcubeassociation.org); 6. Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. items.information: [CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce the third Cape Town competition for 2023. Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, **and** make an EFT payment to confirm your entry. Please see Registration Requirements below. ### SPECTATORS Competitors are welcome to bring up to **two** spectators with them. ### VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". For 4x4 and 5x5 Blindfolded, which will be in the early morning on both days, we ask for competitors to please reach out to us before the competition to volunteer to be judges during these events. By doing so and helping out, you will earn yourself a free cup of coffee/tea/hot chocolate! ### SPONSORSHIP ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbU10IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--03db2d12875f7b21e073b29649b48a5bc813b0e2/image.png) A big thanks to [Speedcubes](https://www.speedcubes.co.za/) who are sponsoring vouchers as a part of the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to try out and buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. ### LUCKY DRAW During prize-giving after 3x3 Finals on Sunday, we will be having a Lucky Draw for two winners to receive R250 Speedcubes.co.za vouchers each with free shipping on their order! If you needed another reason to stick around and watch 3x3 Finals other than the amazing speed of some of Africa's top speedcubers, maybe you could be one of the lucky winners and walk away with some free cubes or apparel courtesy of our local speedcubing store. #### About CubingZA Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact). We are particularly looking for help with communications, and graphic design.

Um mehr darüber zu erfahren, besuche https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2023/. Teilnehmer die sich registrieren aber nicht bezahlen, müssen die Teilnahmegebühr bei ihrer nächsten Competition in der Schweiz bezahlen. ______________________________________________________________________________________________ [FR] Swisscubing Cup Final fait partie de la Swisscubing Cup 2023, composé de 6 compétitions durant l'année. Jette un oeil sur https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2023/ pour plus de détails sur les autres éditions. Les compétiteurs qui s'inscrivent et ne viennent pas à la compétition devront payer les frais d'inscriptions à sa prochaine compétition en Suisse. ______________________________________________________________________________________________ [IT] Swisscubing Cup Final fa parte del Swisscubing Cup 2023, composta da 6 competizioni durante l'intero anno. Vai su https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2023/ per i dettagli delle altre edizioni. Un competitore che si iscrive e non si presenta dovrà pagare la quota di iscrizione alla sua prossima competizione in Svizzera. ______________________________________________________________________________________________ [EN] Swisscubing Cup Final is part of the Swisscubing Cup 2023, made of 6 competitions during the whole year. Check out on https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2023/ for the details of the other editions. A competitor who registers and doesn't show up at the competition will have to pay that registration fee at his next competition in Switzerland.
